rationale: User asked for tab/shell splitting, then palette activation. POC panes are LocalDomain::spawn_pane without a mux Tab, so Mux::split_pane cannot resolve pane→tab. First slice is a GPUI binary tree + extra spawn_pane, laid out with gpui-component h_resizable/v_resizable. SplitHorizontal = left/right (new on right); SplitVertical = top/bottom (new on bottom). Click focuses the leaf for keys. CloseCurrentPane closes that leaf. Pane select/rotate/zoom stay listed. Do not path-dep wezterm-gui. Do not start 026/031.
